author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-13, after Akien said he had about 50 terminal windows of python open: proofs that spawn long-lived scratch processes (bus, ground_loop) leave them behind on Windows and each opens a console. Measured: kill_what_it_started in cairn/devices/tester/runs.py returns 'none: process environments cannot be enumerated on Windows' on nt, so the tester reaps nothing there; and device.py runs the proof with subprocess.run and no creationflags. Census: 25 proof files hold 34 bare Popen calls. Measured by hand, test_shim_starts_the_loop leaves a ground_loop pair running on Windows and never returns. The Linux leak of that proof is ticket ea6e465680a3 and stays there.
